column1: # Bridge methods of 1.4.7 jars, on top of forward/1.6.4/bridge-methods.tsv (format: see there, and BridgeMethods).
# 1.4.7 textures are indices into sprite sheets: a block or item that overrides the int-returning methods gets a bridge method that returns the
# sprite of that index in the sheet its getTextureFile() names (an int result where the new method returns an IIcon goes through
# org/kylepitcock/legacyconnector/v1_6_4/bridge/SpriteSheets147.mcc$icon(owner, index)). The first rule that matches a method wins.
# 1.4.7 onBlockPlacedBy had no ItemStack (1.5 added it): the override is called with the 1.7.10 shaped arguments, the stack dropped
